A playground program imports only what it reaches (rich-animation-42lg.ptj)

effects.ts's new imports (Style, ColorRamp) were copied into every program,
pushing the editable constants under the editor's drawn lines and failing the
playground's e2e specs. Programs now keep the import names their reached
declarations use, one line per module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

A colour ramp moves: scrolls along its span and rotates its hue (rich-animation-42lg.ptj)

ColorRamp carries scroll (spans) and hue (turns), wrapped into [0, 1) in the
constructor; unmoved, every read is exactly what it was. ramp.moving({ scroll,
hue }) is an Animation<ColorRamp> built from Animation.all and map, so a loop
moves every frame and a ramp a tween settles never changes again.

gradient(ramp, colors?) lays an Animation<ColorRamp> across what an element
draws: each lit cell's ink is the ramp's colour at its column, written through
legibleInks, now the one path for an ink of the caller's choosing (steppedInk
shares it). Lit colours are named as a style names them and matched as the
screen shows them at the frame's depth. stillOnSlots holds it still at sixteen
colours. Below truecolor which palette colours read on a pair is settled once
per pair, which took an 80-wide panel at 256 colours from 16 ms to 1.5 ms a
frame.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

An effect moves a cell's attributes, not only its colours (rich-animation-42lg.0wr) (#484)

* An effect moves a cell's attributes, not only its colours (rich-animation-42lg.0wr)

An effect's frame maps a cell's look — its colours and its text attributes,
all but reverse — rather than its colours alone, so confined, onBeat,
Animation.all and nesting take an attribute effect with no second copy.
Effected cuts a run where the attributes change too, and a cell whose look
comes back as drawn is still written byte for byte as it was.

blink(spec) sets an attribute on the second hold of a two-hold beat; the
catalogue's new attributes section makes a blink (conceal) and a bold pulse
from it. Style gains attributes / withAttributes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* An effect moves only the attributes a look names (review: rich-animation-42lg.0wr)

withAttributes reads ATTRIBUTE_NAMES off its argument; Effected picks the
look's attributes through cellAttributes, the one place reverse is left out,
and skips the extra Style when a run's attributes are the segment's own.
